newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria April air cargo up 10.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria April air cargo up 10.4 percent.

text.p: Gran Canaria airport handled 10.4 percent more cargo in April compared with the same month last year, the airport authority said.
Volume rose to 3,179 tonnes compared with 2,880 tonnes, taking the accumulated total this year to 15,407 tonnes, 17.7 percent more than the same period in 1996.
The airport also handled 518 tonnes of mail in April, 4.1 percent less than in April 1996. The accumulated mail total was up 7.5 percent at 1,918 tonnes.

Passenger numbers were 1.3 percent higher in the month at 640,538 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 2.80 million, 2.3 percent ahead of 1996. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
